prompt: On your laptop, news sites keep pulling you away during your homework hour. Which environment change is most likely to help?

options.text: Use a website blocker for those sites during your set homework hour, while keeping the laptop available for work
Remove the web browser from the laptop entirely
Do homework only on days when you feel strong-willed
Keep the news open in a smaller window alongside your homework

explanation: Blocking the distracting sites for just that hour removes the temptation at the moment it usually strikes, instead of depending on resisting it repeatedly while you work.
